project_type: T-Bench debugging task - Register allocator and instruction scheduler for custom bytecode VM
build_system: Docker with python:3.11-slim base, uv for pytest
verification_instructions: 1. Build Docker image. 2. Run pipeline to generate output. 3. Run pytest to validate output matches expected values.
environment_constraints: Python stdlib only at runtime. No pip packages. Must use python:3.11-slim Docker image.
contribution_requirements: PLUTU-LUCKY-CANARY must appear in every file. All paths in instruction.md must be absolute (/app/...). Output schema required in instruction.md.
key_patterns: Follow consensus-ledger-repair structure: environment/Dockerfile, environment/runtime/, tests/test.sh, tests/test_*.py, solution/solve.sh, solution/repair_*.py, instruction.md, task.toml. Pipeline writes JSON report, tests validate against expected values.
directory_structure: Root contains task directories (one per t-bench task). Each task has: environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime/), tests/ (test.sh + test_*.py), solution/ (solve.sh + repair_*.py), instruction.md, task.toml
